description: Separate persistent Activity reads, realtime Event tails, and protected dead-letter recovery into explicit singular mo CLI entry points.

tasks.title: Expose the Activity card collection API
tasks.description: Add the project-scoped Activity collection endpoint that returns the existing AgentOps feed's session cards as a finite normal API collection. Keep the Web-facing /agent/activity composite response and Activity aggregation unchanged, validate the 1 through 200 limit at the API boundary, and prove the collection remains project-isolated.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/activity returns the existing Activity feed session-card collection in the normal API envelope without summary or waiting-card companions.
The endpoint defaults to 50 records, accepts limits from 1 through 200, rejects out-of-range limits with a client error, and resolves project scope through the existing project filter.

Server specs cover project isolation, default and valid limits, invalid-limit rejection, and equivalence between the new collection response and the existing /agent/activity session cards while preserving existing Web-feed specs.
tasks.output: A read-only project Activity collection endpoint and focused server specification coverage.
tasks.notes: Delegate to AgentActivityFeedAssembler; do not create a new Activity persistence model or change the existing Web feed contract.

tasks.title: Deliver the persistent activity list CLI
tasks.description: Add the singular Activity command group and its list leaf on top of the new collection endpoint. Reuse ProjectRef and JsonSelection contracts, define the Activity-card collection descriptor, and provide a scan-oriented human table plus selected JSON output without treating Activity as an Event stream.
acceptanceCriteria: mo activity list resolves a project through --project or the active project, calls the Activity collection endpoint with a 1 through 200 limit, and fails locally without HTTP for no active project or an invalid limit.
The command exposes bare --json discovery, rejects invalid fields locally with exit code 2, and emits a JSON array containing only selected Activity-card fields for --json <fields>.

Default output renders issue/workflow context, session identity, status, model, and last activity in a dedicated Activity table; repeated reads of unchanged data are finite normal reads rather than a subscription.

CLI specs cover route/query construction, project override, local validation, JSON discovery/selection, table rendering, and re-readable results; dotnet test packages/cli/tests/Mohist.Cli.Tests/Mohist.Cli.Tests.csproj passes.
tasks.output: mo activity list, its collection descriptor/table renderer, and CLI specification coverage.
tasks.notes: Use PrintResourceAsync with a command-owned ResourceDescriptor; retain the existing /agent/activity Web response unchanged.

tasks.title: Migrate Event operations to singular command entries
tasks.description: Move tail and dead-letter commands from the plural events root to the singular event root, retaining all existing stream, matching, cancellation, credential, loopback, and sanitization behavior. Complete the command-surface separation by removing plural navigation and event list paths, preserving routing as its own entry, and updating CLI help, examples, documentation, and regression coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: mo event tail and mo event dead-letter list/redeliver resolve and preserve their existing HTTP routes and behavior: tail remains post-subscription NDJSON with server-compiled --match and exit 130 cancellation, while dead-letter keeps limit/filter/id validation, operator credentials, loopback refusal, result reporting, and terminal-text sanitization.
mo events tail, mo events dead-letter list, and mo event list fail as unknown command paths without HTTP; root help advertises singular activity and event but not plural events.

Leaf help distinguishes persistent Activity history, realtime Event subscription origin, and dead-letter recovery side effects, exposes no shared --mode or --source switch, and Event commands do not gain routing rule CRUD or routing test behavior.

All affected CLI tests use singular Event invocations and add regressions for plural removal, event list absence, root help, and retained tail/dead-letter safety behavior; docs/cli-reference.md removes the shared-events implementation gap and plural Event examples without changing unrelated issue events or routing payload fields.
tasks.output: Singular mo event command tree, updated help/docs, and complete CLI regression coverage for Event/dead-letter separation.
tasks.notes: This is intentionally breaking. Keep server /api/.../events paths plural and do not retain an events alias.
